title: Read a table item
summary: COBOL: Read a table item. Read SCORE(3).
introduction: OCCURS makes repeated data items. Subscripts start at 1 in COBOL.
learningObjectives: Read a table item with COBOL

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.

blocks.title: Read a table item
blocks.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 SCORES.
 05 SCORE PIC 9 OCCURS 3 TIMES.
procedure division.
MOVE 4 TO SCORE(1)
MOVE 5 TO SCORE(2)
MOVE 8 TO SCORE(3)
DISPLAY SCORE(2)
stop run.

blocks.text: Three MOVE steps fill the table. SCORE(2) reads its middle item, 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A table subscript must stay within its declared count.
